Application development project

Airport Sky Base System

The problem

Airport information needs a usable interface that supports access to records and operational workflows.

My contribution

I developed and tested an airport management application focused on accessing and managing airport information.

Technologies and approach

Application interface design, information management and functional testing. Implementation details are available in the repository.

What it delivers

The project provides a user interface for working with airport information and demonstrates application development and testing.

Current status

This is a repository-based project; it is not presented as a live airport operations system.
